ai_summary: ESIC provides medical and cash benefits to covered workers (wage <= Rs. 21,000) via employer enrolment.
ai_explanation: ESIC is a contributory social insurance scheme where employer and employee contribute a percentage of wages. Covered workers and their families get cashless medical care plus sickness, maternity, and disability benefits. Enrolment is done by the employer.
eligibility_summary: Employees with wage up to Rs. 21,000/month (Rs. 25,000 for persons with disability) in ESIC-covered factories/establishments.
